name: Halftone Collage
summary: Editorial stop-motion collage: black-and-white halftone cut-outs with cream keylines and a few coloured cardstock pieces slide in on twos and lock together on a flat saturated paper field; words only as printed paper strips; between beats an endless zoom through the layers.

palette.use: field red: time being spent, labour, urgency (the default field)
field: norms, things settling into memory
field: cognition, taste, a reset (ink green, proposed)
field: burnt orange, time and urgency (proposed)
newsprint: the paper of every halftone cut-out and word strip
printing ink: halftone dots and the type on strips
the thin warm-cream keyline round every piece
grey ink for small print on strips (proposed)
paper fibre and the strip's torn shadow side (proposed)
cyan cardstock: the key item of a line (here blue light)
yellow cardstock: a second key item (here the sun)

type.emphasis: the word printed on a cardstock strip instead of newsprint

banned: type anywhere but on a printed paper or cardstock strip; subtitles; the whole voice-over line on screen
logos, watermarks, UI, readable signage inside the cut-outs
fades, slight drift or shake, slow zooms inside an assembling shot, morphing, objects appearing from nothing
glossy 3D, photoreal environments, gradients on the field
colour for colour's sake: cut-outs are black-and-white halftone; cardstock colour only on the key item
cobalt blue as a field, and a field that changes inside one shot
a screen full of small fragments: 3–6 large separable pieces
a moving camera while pieces assemble (the camera moves only in the zoom between beats)
AI-generated or downloaded photos standing in for drawn halftone cut-outs in this catalog version
